section_summary.extract_value: This section investigates the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, self-esteem, appearance evaluation, Western ideal beauty internalization, and eating concerns. It details a mediation analysis using a nonparametric bootstrapping approach to test if Western beauty ideal internalization mediates the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, eating concern, shape concern, and weight concern. The study found that ethnic identity was positively associated with body appreciation (BAS) in women, and Western beauty ideal internalization mediated relations between ethnic identity and eating, shape, and weight concerns, but not body appreciation.

section_summary.extract_value: This section investigates the relationship between ethnic identity (MEIM) and various psychological constructs, including body appreciation (BAS), self-esteem, appearance evaluation, Western beauty ideal internalization, and eating/shape/weight concerns.
